EnvironmentVariables.//: Site containing the document library. No trailing path beyond the site name.
The library's URL name, which is frequently different from its display name (Documents vs Shared Documents). Use the value in the browser address bar.
Server-relative path of the source root. The walk starts here.
Server-relative path of the template folder. MUST be disjoint from the output folder, otherwise the solution's own writes re-trigger Flow A.
Folder that receives regenerated documents. Never walked as a source, but paths are computed into it.
Folder that receives the previous version of every overwritten output. Never walked as a source.

JSON array of folder names never walked as sources, wherever they appear in the tree. Held as configuration so exclusions can change without editing the flow. Excluded subtrees are dropped before enqueueing, so a subtree of any size costs nothing.
JSON array of lower-case extensions supported by the deployed PD Conversion Assistant skill. Legacy .doc files must be migrated to .docx before entering the source tree.
Documents claimed per Flow B run. THROTTLE 1 OF 2. Set from measured worst-case agent latency, not the average: one slow document stalls a sequential loop. Starts deliberately low for the pilot.
Retry ceiling per work item, after which it is parked as Failed for human review. Unbounded retry on a deterministic failure is the classic way to exhaust a quota overnight.
CIRCUIT BREAKER. Above this count the run is held for a second, deliberate confirmation. Stops a wrong template or a misconfigured filter becoming a large bill.
Items left InProgress beyond this are reset to Pending at the start of each cycle. Without reaping, a crashed batch strands its claimed items forever.
Folders processed per Flow E run before re-queueing and exiting. Keeps any single run well inside the duration limit regardless of tree size.

When true, Flow A plans work items for inspection and the run is never executed. Zero agent cost. DEFAULTS TO TRUE so a fresh deployment cannot regenerate documents before anyone has looked at the plan.
Recipient for approval requests, run summaries and failure alerts.
Schema name of the existing PD Conversion Assistant agent invoked through shared_agentnode/InvokeAgent. The agent is referenced, not copied into this solution.
Name of the document index list. Parameterised so a test deployment can point at its own copy without touching production data.
Name of the run header list. Parameterised so a test deployment can point at its own copy without touching production data.
Name of the work queue list. Parameterised so a test deployment can point at its own copy without touching production data.
Holds the folder walk frontier. Persisted rather than held in an array variable so the walk is resumable, observable, and immune to the 16 MB action output cap.
